section_header: REAR AXLE AND SUSPENSION — IRS Type Rear Suspension
title: REPLACEMENT OF REAR SUSPENSION ARM BUSHING

content.text: REPLACEMENT OF REAR SUSPENSION ARM BUSHING

items: (a) Check the bushing for wear, cracks or deterioration.
(b) Check the arm for damage, cracks or deformation.

content.description: Rear suspension arm showing three bushing locations with circular callouts

content.text: (a) Cut off the flange tip of the bushing as shown in the figure.

content.description: Close-up view of bushing showing flange tip to be cut off

content.text: (b) Bend the remaining portions inward with a cold chisel.
Be careful not to damage the flange.

content.description: Illustration showing bending operation using cold chisel and hammer on bushing

content.text: (c) Bend in the flange tips and pull off the flange with a pair of pliers.
Bend the remaining flange portion so the SST can be installed to the lower arm.

content.description: Illustration showing pulling off flange with pliers

content.text: (d) Using SST, press out the outer bushing from the arm.

content.label: SST
content.description: Special Service Tool for pressing out bushing
Diagram showing SST tool setup with downward arrow indicating press direction for removing outer bushing
